item.text: The starter has only a database opener; I’m adding a shared schema and job mapper, then the server routes and worker loop. The worker will persist retry timing and heartbeat state in SQLite so health and recovery work across process restarts.
The implementation builds cleanly. I’m running the repository’s smoke and contract checks now; they exercise server startup, API validation/idempotency, progress, and retry behavior.

Implemented the SQLite-backed job API, retrying worker, and polling browser UI. The server and worker share durable job and idempotency state in SQLite.

`npm run build` passes, and the worker starts. The smoke and contract checks could not run because this environment blocks binding to `127.0.0.1` (`listen EPERM`).
